entities.summary: Rimini Haraya Makama is a lawyer, entrepreneur and a corporate executive. She is the Executive Commissioner of Stakeholder Management at the Nigerian Communications Commission. Makama was confirmed to her position by the Nigerian Senate on 21 May 2024 following her nomination by President Bola Ahmed Tinubu GCFR on 23 February 2024.
